title: Skip Wuzhen's ¥150 Ticket — This 1,300-Year-Old Canal Town Is Free | China Travel Expert
description:
China's famous water towns charge to get in — Wuzhen's Xizha zone is about ¥150, and a combined ticket runs up to ¥190. Skip it. This canal town is just as old, and it's free.

Shaxi Ancient Town sits in Taicang, about an hour from Shanghai. It has more than 1,300 years of Ming- and Qing-era waterfront streets, stone bridges and canals — and there's no ticket gate to walk in (a few small indoor sights sell a ¥30 combo). Locals still live and trade along the water, so it feels far less staged than the big managed towns. Would you skip the paid town for a free one? Tell me I'm wrong.

🧭 Expert Tip: go on a weekday — Shaxi stays quiet, and the early-morning light on the canal is the best photo you'll get.
